{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Parse revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter out QA orders and refunded orders
df_clean = df[(df['revenue'] != 999999.99) & (df['status'] == 'completed')]

# Check the result
print(f"Total rows after filtering: {len(df_clean)}")
print(f"Channel distribution: \n{df_clean['channel'].value_counts()}")
print(f"Customer segment distribution: \n{df_clean['customer_segment'].value_counts()}")

# Check for confounding: cross-tabulate channel vs customer_segment
print(f"\nChannel vs Customer Segment:\n{pd.crosstab(df_clean['channel'], df_clean['customer_segment'])}")"}
